description: An eight by eight grid of loop recorders, one row per input, with one cell of a row playing at a time, scene buttons that fire a whole column, and a small mixer with two send buses

params.text: Chooses whether a click on a cell takes effect at once or is held back to a clock boundary: Free, or every 1, 8, 16, 32 or 64 clocks
Stops every playing cell, and cancels anything waiting to start
Fires every cell in that column at once: the ones with a recording play, and the empty ones stop whatever is playing in their row
Sets how much of that row goes to the A send, 0 to 1, after its level and pan
Sets how much of that row goes to the B send, 0 to 1, after its level and pan
Places that row in the stereo mix, fully left at the bottom of its travel and fully right at the top
Sets that row's level, 0 to 1, before the pan, the sends and the mix

inputs.text: Each rising edge above 1V counts one clock; the quantise setting counts in these, and the length of a recorded loop is measured in them
A rising edge above 1V puts the clock count back to zero and restarts every playing cell from its beginning
A rising edge above 1V fires that column, as pressing its button does
A rising edge above 1V stops every playing cell
The signal that a cell in that row records; it is the only source that row can record from
A signal added straight into the left mix output, untouched by anything else on this panel
A signal added straight into the right mix output, untouched by anything else on this panel
A signal added straight into the left mix output, untouched by anything else on this panel
A signal added straight into the right mix output, untouched by anything else on this panel

outputs.text: Whatever that row is playing, after its level knob and before the pan
The left side of the A send: every row at its A amount and its pan, added together
The right side of the A send: every row at its A amount and its pan, added together
The left side of the B send: every row at its B amount and its pan, added together
The right side of the B send: every row at its B amount and its pan, added together
Every row at its level and pan, plus both returns, added together

notes: the cells are one display widget, so a click on one cannot reach this help.
click an empty cell to record from that row's input, click again to stop; click a recorded cell to play it, click again to stop it.
hold a cell down for a second to clear it, drag it onto another cell to move the recording there, and hold Shift while dragging to copy it instead.
only one cell in a row sounds at a time; starting one fades the one already playing out. Recording happens in one cell at a time across the whole grid.
a cell holds at most ten seconds at 48000 samples a second, and recording stops of its own accord when that runs out.
menu: Playback Speed — on a cell's own right-click menu: ten fixed speeds from -8x to 8x and a slider between them; a negative figure plays the loop backwards and zero silences it
